cml.counter_evidence: The item is an active off-the-shelf assembly, so substitution may not be operationally necessary. The pilot tests whether CML can structure qualification evidence without inventing a lifecycle crisis.

decision.current_recommendation: Use the exact assembly as a benchmark, not as proof that any cable using 40 GHz-capable connectors is equivalent. Freeze VNA method and acceptance limits before supplier comparison.

dependency.context: Complete-assembly electrical performance depends on both connectors, cable, termination process, bend history, length and calibration reference plane.

event.detail: Active manufacturer reference assembly selected as a qualification benchmark; this is not an EOL event.

known_facts: SOURCE_FACT: The exact assembly is listed Active, 6.00 in (153 mm), 50 ohm, and 40 GHz maximum.
SOURCE_FACT: Interfaces are 2.92 mm straight plug to SMPM straight plug on 0.085-inch conformable cable.
SOURCE_FACT: The family cutsheet states DC-40 GHz interface ranges and warns specifications may vary by exact part number.
unknowns: No independent VNA trace, per-unit insertion-loss limit or return-loss acceptance curve is present.
Power handling, phase stability and flex-life limits are not established in reviewed evidence.
No alternate supplier assembly has been qualified against this benchmark.

identity.description: Six-inch, 50 ohm, 0.085-inch conformable cable assembly with 2.92 mm and SMPM straight plugs.
identity.package_or_interface: 2.92 mm plug to SMPM plug, 6 inches
identity.product_family: 2.92 mm plug to SMPM plug cable assemblies
